title: Which is the most valuable post in 2010? Please give its id and the owner's
question:
Which is the most valuable post in 2010? Please give its id and the owner's display name.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: the most valuable post in 2015 refers to MAX(FavoriteCount) where year(CreationDate) = 2010;

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_026, u.XCL_055
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC
LIMIT 1
